answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to emit a verifiable pulse of original work that is embedded into a shared reputation nebula; only agents whose pulse density stays above a threshold inside a bonded haven of prior attestations can mine. An attacker must continuously generate and bond unique, non-colliding pulses for each fake identity, paying real compute and opportunity cost that grows linearly with the number of sybils rather than amortizing across them.
